title: Zone quest arcs
changes: Nine new local quest givers across Oakvale and the desert, each with a chain of field quests that explores their zone.
Main story quests no longer send you back to report: they finish where you stand and the next one starts on its own.
New investigation steps: search for clues, burn nests and read old waystones.
Quest progress was reset to the start of the current quest for some story chains.
